spans.text: **Verify, Don't Assume**: Do not Reference non-existent files. If you aren't sure a file exists, check it first.
spans.note: The prompt strongly emphasizes investigation before planning, verification over assumption, and grounding plans in reality. It explicitly instructs the agent to not guess and to verify file existence before referencing them, promoting information integrity.
